title: Goteborgsregionens Tekniska Gymnasium
description: gtg.se zoominfo.com/c/göteborgsregionens-tekniska-gymnasium/458572877 GTG technical upper-secondary school (gymnasium) owned by 13 Gothenburg-area municipalities (via the Göteborgsregionens kommunalförbund) — founded in 2006 specifically to solve the region's engineering talent shortage, the first inter-municipal school of its kind in Sweden. Located inside Lindholmen Science Park next to Chalmers, Volvo, SKF and Saab — a genuine "school inside an industrial cluster" with guest lectures, real projects, internships and equipment from industry partners. Programs: Teknikprogrammet (design & product development, production, IT/media tech) and El- och energiprogrammet (automation, electricity, energy) — ~700–900 students, tuition-free, with graduates feeding directly into Chalmers engineering programs or industrial apprenticeships.
